Chesapeake Bay from Sandy Point to North Beach-
127 AM EST Fri Nov 6 2026

...SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY IN EFFECT FROM LATE TONIGHT THROUGH SATURDAY
AFTERNOON...

.OVERNIGHT...S winds 10 kt. Waves 1 ft. Numerous showers and
scattered tstms. Patchy fog. Vsby 1 NM or less. 
.FRI...SW winds 10 kt...becoming N in the late morning and early
afternoon, then becoming E late. Waves 1 ft. Showers and scattered
tstms. Patchy fog. Vsby 1 NM or less. 
.FRI NIGHT...SE winds 5 to 10 kt...becoming W late in the evening,
then becoming NW 10 to 15 kt with gusts to 25 kt after midnight.
Waves flat...building to 2 ft after midnight. 
.SAT...NW winds 15 to 20 kt with gusts to 30 kt. Waves 2 ft. 
.SAT NIGHT...W winds 15 to 20 kt with gusts to 25 kt. Waves 2 ft. 
.SUN...W winds 10 to 15 kt with gusts to 20 kt. Waves 2 ft. 
.SUN NIGHT...W winds 10 to 15 kt with gusts to 20 kt. Waves 1 to
2 ft. 
.MON...NW winds 15 to 20 kt...becoming W 5 to 10 kt. Waves 1 to
2 ft. 
.TUE...W winds 5 to 10 kt. Waves 1 ft.  

Winds and waves higher and visibilities lower in and near tstms.
